# Jackrabbit Punkin Publishing LLC

> Jackrabbit Punkin Publishing LLC is an independent publisher founded by U.S. Navy veterans Barbara J. Ratliff and Charles Ratliff, publishing mission-driven books including the memoir "Battles Beyond the Waves" and operating the Read It Forward community literacy program.

Jackrabbit Punkin Publishing LLC (JPP) is a small, family-founded press. Its debut title, Battles Beyond the Waves, is a memoir by co-founder Barbara J. Ratliff about her 20 years of service in the United States Navy. JPP also runs the Read It Forward Program, which places sponsored books into the hands of veterans, students, and underserved communities.

## Books
- [Battles Beyond the Waves](https://jackrabbitpunkinpublishing.com/books.html): Veteran memoir by Barbara J. Ratliff, available in hardcover, paperback, and Kindle edition.
- [Book Club Resources](https://jackrabbitpunkinpublishing.com/book-club.html): Discussion guides, author visits, and signed copies for book clubs reading Battles Beyond the Waves.

- [Policies](https://jackrabbitpunkinpublishing.com/policies.html): Privacy, terms, refund, shipping, accessibility, and copyright policies.

## Programs
- [Read It Forward Program](https://jackrabbitpunkinpublishing.com/read-it-forward.html): Community literacy initiative that sponsors books for veterans, schools, and underserved communities.

## Speaking
- [Invite Barbara to Speak](https://jackrabbitpunkinpublishing.com/speaking.html): Keynotes, panels, workshops, and interviews on military resilience, women in the military, faith, and storytelling.
